tests.redaction_note: Raw test log contains a personal LANE_TEST_REPO path; preserved locally, not copied.

review.causal_inputs: Only each recorded image's exact acknowledged motion prefix is integrated; later arrivals/latest poses cannot substitute. Sensor, arrival and committed QPC must precede capture, and source pose must precede image within the original100ms tail gate.
review.odometer_semantics: The original recorded sensor receipt is converted using integer ticks_ns; recorded source_now_ns and consumed_qpc feed the same real core accept_gyro/accept_wheels calls as MotionChannel. A direct runtime-channel/oracle test compares every call argument and resulting sample. No image time is substituted as motion consumption now.
review.pose_verification: All raw odometry and teach-frame priors were recomputed and match recording digests. Raw recorded poses are hashed for checks only, not fed to the estimator.
review.image_semantics: Exact PNG bytes and original camera calibration are retained; digest validation occurs during export and replay. The first rejected recorded map ends the fixture; no future recovery frames are synthesized.
review.core_timing: Mapping replay uses normal TeachMapEngine.process with its original clocks/default budgets. No commit guard or transport scheduler is invented.
review.transport_missing: Original image HTTP arrival_qpc and every individual MMF read/commit-guard time are absent. The fixture explicitly stores arrival_qpc=null, original step receipt/processing, capture and HTTP delivery timestamps. It cannot reproduce arrival200ms, commit-time200ms, continuous watchdog checks, generation-lock interleavings, or prove a changed algorithm satisfies runtime freshness.
review.delivery: Prepared computation is paired with the same epoch/sequence HTTP-write-completed record. Delivery is not Unity acknowledgement or successful actuation.
review.partial_failure: If fixture validation raises after a prior valid motion sample, that partial offline object is discarded; it is not a live runtime recovery path.
review.generalization: This is schema2 support for the recorded independent protocol, not a conversion to legacy batches. Legacy schema1 behavior remains separate and its five existing helper tests pass.
